lemmas.name: missing54
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Nat) (h : missingNumber_precond nums), missingNumber_postcond nums (((List.range (nums.length + 1)).find? (fun x => decide (x ∉ nums))).getD 0) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums h
  obtain ⟨hall, hnd⟩ := h
  have hsub : nums ⊆ List.range (nums.length + 1) := fun x hx => List.mem_range.mpr (by
    have := List.all_eq_true.mp hall x hx; simp at this; omega)
  have hex : ∃ x ∈ List.range (nums.length + 1), x ∉ nums := by
    by_contra hno
    push_neg at hno
    have hsub2 : List.range (nums.length + 1) ⊆ nums := fun x hx => hno x hx
    have := (List.nodup_range.subperm hsub2).length_le
    simp at this
  have hany : (List.range (nums.length + 1)).any (fun x => decide (x ∉ nums)) = true :=
    List.any_eq_true.mpr (by obtain ⟨x, hx, hn⟩ := hex; exact ⟨x, hx, by simpa using hn⟩)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hmem, hp⟩ := Refine.find_some_of_any _ _ hany
  have hrn : r ∉ nums := by simpa using hp
  unfold missingNumber_postcond
  dsimp only
  rw [hr, Option.getD_some]
  refine ⟨hmem, hrn, ?_⟩
  intro x hx hxr
  by_contra hxn
  have hsub3 : nums ⊆ ((List.range (nums.length + 1)).erase x).erase r := by
    intro y hy
    have hyr : y ≠ r := fun e => hrn (e ▸ hy)
    have hyx : y ≠ x := fun e => hxn (e ▸ hy)
    rw [List.mem_erase_of_ne hyr, List.mem_erase_of_ne hyx]; exact hsub hy
  have hl := (hnd.subperm hsub3).length_le
  have hrmem : r ∈ (List.range (nums.length + 1)).erase x := (List.mem_erase_of_ne (Ne.symm hxr)).mpr hmem
  rw [List.length_erase_of_mem hrmem, List.length_erase_of_mem hx] at hl
  simp at hl
  have hxlt := List.mem_range.mp hx
  have hrlt := List.mem_range.mp hmem
  omega
